summary: Use a Payment Feedback on the screen after a payment to show the amount, whether it went through, and its reference.

useWhen.text: On the screen after a payment, to show the amount, whether it went through, and its reference.

from.quote: Use a Payment Feedback on the screen after a payment to show the amount, whether it went through, and its reference.

avoidWhen.text: Before the payment has a result: Payment Feedback has no pressed, disabled or loading state, and the screen shows it once the payment has a result.

configuration.text: Set the outcome with AppearanceSystem in modes: positive is green, warning orange, and negative red.

from.quote: Set the outcome with AppearanceSystem in modes: positive is green, warning orange, and negative red.

configuration.text: The icon and the words don't follow AppearanceSystem: set iconName and the status line (subtitle) to match it.

from.quote: The icon and the words don't follow it, so set iconName and the status line to match.

configuration.text: Paid: positive with ic_confirm, the default: a check on green.

from.quote: positive with ic_confirm, the default: a check on green.

configuration.text: Pending: warning with ic_info, while the bank hasn't confirmed it.

from.quote: warning with ic_info, while the bank hasn't confirmed it.

configuration.text: Failed: negative with ic_close: a white cross on red.

from.quote: negative with ic_close: a white cross on red.

configuration.text: Do not keep the default check on a failed payment: a check mark on red says success and failure at once.

from.quote: A check mark on red says success and failure at once.

configuration.text: iconName defaults to ic_confirm whatever the outcome: set it for a pending or failed payment.
subtitle defaults to “Payment successful” whatever the outcome: set it for a pending or failed payment.
title defaults to “₹50,000”: pass the amount that was paid.
details defaults to a sample date and transaction ID (18 March 2025, TXN121466784): pass the payment's own, or set showDetails false.
Set showDetails false to hide the date and reference.

from.quote: showDetails off hides the date and reference.

configuration.text: renderMedia replaces the icon with your own.

from.quote: renderMedia replaces the icon with your own.

configuration.text: Of Payment Feedback's modes, set only AppearanceSystem.

from.quote: Of the modes, set only AppearanceSystem

configuration.text: Do not set AppearanceBrand on it: it changes nothing.

from.quote: AppearanceBrand and Page type change nothing

configuration.text: Do not set Page type on it: it changes nothing.

configuration.text: Do not set Icon Capsule Size, Emphasis or Semantic Intent for the default icon: it keeps its own size, emphasis and intent.

rules.text: Lead with the amount, then say the outcome in words.

from.quote: Lead with the amount, then say the outcome in words.

rules.text: Write the amount as it was paid, with its currency sign: the component adds none.

from.quote: Write the amount as it was paid, with its currency sign: the component adds none.

rules.text: Do not write a sentence in the title: 36 px heavy text wraps into a block nobody reads first.

from.quote: 36 px heavy text wraps into a block nobody reads first.

rules.text: Put the outcome in the status line, in sentence case.

from.quote: Put the outcome in the status line in sentence case

rules.text: Do not rely on the colour to give the outcome: say it in the status line.

from.quote: Rely on the colour

rules.text: Keep the body to one sentence.

from.quote: keep the body to one sentence

rules.text: Give the details one fact per line, split with a line break.

examples.purpose: A successful payment: the amount, the outcome, who it went to, then the date and transaction ID.
examples.jsx:
<PaymentFeedback
  title="₹1,250"
  subtitle="Payment successful"
  body="Sent to Rahul Sharma."
  details={'13 October 2026, 4:15 pm\nTransaction ID: TXN121466784'}
  iconName="ic_confirm"
/>

from.quote: ₹1,250, “Payment successful”, who it went to, then the date and transaction ID.

examples.purpose: A failed payment: negative with ic_close, and the outcome in words.
examples.jsx:
<PaymentFeedback
  title="₹1,250"
  subtitle="Payment failed"
  body="Something went wrong. Please try again."
  details={'13 October 2026, 4:15 pm\nTransaction ID: TXN121466784'}
  iconName="ic_close"
  modes={{ AppearanceSystem: 'negative' }}
/>

from.quote: negative with ic_close: a white cross on red.

examples.purpose: A payment result screen: the result centred, with Done below to leave, since Payment Feedback has no button of its own.
examples.jsx:
<VStack justifyVertical="space-between" style={{ flex: 1, padding: 16 }}>
  <VStack justifyVertical="center" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
    <PaymentFeedback
      title="₹1,250"
      subtitle="Payment successful"
      body="Sent to Rahul Sharma."
      details={'13 October 2026, 4:15 pm\nTransaction ID: TXN121466784'}
      iconName="ic_confirm"
    />
  </VStack>
  <Button label="Done" onPress={() => {}} />
</VStack>

props.name: title
props.description: An empty string renders no title line. Declared: Large heading text, typically a monetary value (e.g. "₹50,000") Default "₹50,000", from the component source.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: An empty string renders no status line. Declared: Status line below the title (e.g. "Payment successful") Default "Payment successful", from the component source.

props.name: body
props.description: Descriptive body text below the subtitle.

props.name: details
props.description: showDetails false or an empty details string removes the details block. Declared: Transaction metadata shown at the bottom (e.g. date, transaction ID). Supports newlines. Default "18 March 2025, 4:15 pm\nTransaction ID: TXN121466784", from the component source.

props.name: showDetails
props.description: Whether to render the details section. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: iconName
props.description: Icon name used in the default IconCapsule media slot. Default "ic_confirm", from the component source.

props.name: renderMedia
props.description: Replaces the default capsule; the node gets the Payment Feedback's modes under its own. Declared: Optional custom media slot that replaces the default IconCapsule.

props.name: modes
props.description: On the default capsule the caller's AppearanceSystem wins, and its size, emphasis and intent are forced (Icon Capsule Size L, Emphasis High, Semantic Intent System). Declared: Mode configuration for design tokens. Also drives the default IconCapsule's color — pass `AppearanceSystem: 'positive' | 'warning' | 'negative'` to render a green/orange/red capsule (defaults to `positive`).

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: Listed for PaymentFeedback, but changes nothing. Declared: A token collection PaymentFeedback reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: AppearanceSystem
modes.description: There is no status prop: the outcome is AppearanceSystem (positive green, warning orange, negative red) plus iconName and the words. Declared: A token collection PaymentFeedback reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection PaymentFeedback reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Context
modes.description: Nudge&Alert shrinks the default capsule to 14 px and CTACard to 58 px. Declared: A token collection PaymentFeedback reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Emphasis
modes.description: Listed for PaymentFeedback, but changes nothing: the default capsule keeps High. Declared: A token collection PaymentFeedback reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Icon Capsule Size
modes.description: Listed for PaymentFeedback, but changes nothing: the default capsule keeps L. Declared: A token collection PaymentFeedback reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Page type
modes.description: Listed for PaymentFeedback, but changes nothing. Declared: A token collection PaymentFeedback reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Semantic Intent
modes.description: Listed for PaymentFeedback, but changes nothing: the default capsule keeps System. Declared: A token collection PaymentFeedback reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: renderMedia
slots.description: Optional custom media slot that replaces the default IconCapsule

gaps.text: Figma's Payment Feedback shows only a successful payment; pending and failed exist only in code, through AppearanceSystem.
It doesn't announce the result: it has no live region or alert role.
